description.value: Langley Farm Market is a Metro Vancouver grocery chain that has operated for over 25 years with a focus on freshly picked produce sourced directly from BC farms, including Okanagan fruit and locally grown organic vegetables. The Maple Ridge 207 Street location carries a broad range of products: local and organic produce, fresh meat, chilled seafood, deli cold cuts, and in-store baked goods. The chain won the 2025 Vancouver Consumer Choice Award for Best Fruit & Vegetable Market, making it a well-regarded resupply stop for cyclists passing through Maple Ridge.
